## Today

`EndOfRaceViewModel.init` (`app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/endofrace/EndOfRaceViewModel.kt`,
lines 38-43) already calls `ProfileRepository.updateCorrectionFactor`
with `finalRace.retainedFactors.lastOrNull()?.factor.toFloat()`, guarded
by `?.let` so it is skipped entirely when `retainedFactors` is empty —
in that case the stored `correctionFactor` is left unchanged. This is
exactly the behaviour the gap asks for: the last retained factor's
value becomes the profile's when the finished race holds retained
factors, and the stored value is untouched when it holds none.
`ProfileRepositoryImpl.updateCorrectionFactor`
(`core-data/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/data/profile/ProfileRepositoryImpl.kt:91`)
persists it and never fails, matching `docs/CURRENT_TECHNICAL_STATE.md`'s
own description of `EndOfRaceViewModel`. Tests
(`app-wear/src/test/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/endofrace/EndOfRaceViewModelTest.kt:262-296`)
cover both the non-empty and the empty-`retainedFactors` cases.
